title: Remote runner input bundles exceed the 262144-byte mailbox body cap; expose the bound and provide a supported large-payload route
outcome: Remote runner input bundles exceed the 262144-byte mailbox body cap; expose the bound and provide a supported large-payload route
acceptance: The mailbox body size limit is stated in the native tool contract (termal_send_to_session and the CLI help), and an over-limit send is refused with a message naming the limit and the supported large-payload route

A supported route delivers an input bundle larger than the mailbox cap to a remote runner session (for example a content-addressed attachment or a chunked transfer with a manifest and an end-to-end hash check), with no ad hoc base64 splitting by the sender
A test or one live remote delivery proves that a bundle above the cap arrives intact and verifies by its SHA256
The change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
